capabilities.name: Identity lossless codec
capabilities.description: Passes input bytes through unchanged as a baseline codec.

capabilities.name: Zlib RFC 1950 stream codec
capabilities.description: Encodes and decodes lossless zlib-wrapped DEFLATE streams with a stable wire-format identifier and bounded decompression output.

capabilities.name: Local ordered lossless codec pipeline
capabilities.description: Applies ordered codec stages and verifies reconstructed source size and SHA-256 digest.

capabilities.name: Deterministic local baseline benchmark
capabilities.description: Generates deterministic synthetic workloads and compares local identity and zlib payload sizes, timings, traced peak memory, and exact reconstruction.
limitations: One local sample per workload/codec is a smoke-test baseline, not publishable performance evidence.
Does not include serialized capsule metadata, indexes, dictionaries, network transfer, coordination, replication, or recovery.

capabilities.name: Representation Capsule JSON Schema
capabilities.description: Proposed JSON Schema for describing representation identity, exactness guarantees, pipeline stages, dependencies, reconstruction, operations, integrity, and provenance.
limitations: Schema validation and compatibility policy are not yet integrated into CI.
A valid capsule is not proof that its claims or dependencies are trustworthy.

capabilities.name: Adaptive pipeline selection
capabilities.description: Selects compatible representation stages under workload, exactness, resource, and trust constraints.
limitations: No pipeline compiler or adaptive selector is implemented.

explicit_non_capabilities: General computation over arbitrary compressed data
Production deployment or performance superiority claims
